_comment: The deployment briefing played on the briefing room's screen: slides, each with a line said over it. A line is phrases ("clip": a recording, "text": its subtitle) and things of the site's said in their own words ("say": planet, site, temperature, wind, visibility, map). Every clip is a recording to be made: phrases at Assets/Audio/<clip>/, and the site's words at Assets/Audio/Briefing/Words/<word>/ (lower case, spaces as underscores) and its numbers at Assets/Audio/Briefing/Numbers/<n>/ (0 to 19, 20, 30 ... 90, and hundred). A clip not yet recorded is silent but still subtitled and timed. The words here are placeholders to be rewritten.

line.text: Objective: locate the terminal, download the data, and bring the drive back to the shuttle.

map_given.text: A map of the site is on file.

map_missing.text: There is no map of the site on file.
